items.title: Indian education minister resigns after protests
items.description: Protesters have been calling for Dharmandra Pradhan's resignation amid ongoing exam paper leaks, which the education minister claims he "took responsibility" for.

items.title: Houthis and Saudi Arabia trade fire amid Red Sea blockade
items.description: Houthi rebels have claimed a missile attack on Saudia Arabia's southern city of Jazan, after Riyadh struck military targets in Yemen following the Iran-backed group's Red Sea blockade.

items.title: Two people shot by police during altercation in Cairns
items.description: Police say a woman and a man have been shot in Cairns during an altercation with an armed suspect.

items.title: Live: Dolphins to continue dominance in the pool as netball gets underway
items.description: Day two of the Commonwealth Games will see Australia start its netball gold medal defence against Tonga and the Dolphins swim team add more medals to the tally. Follow live.

items.title: Drivers urged to play their part as five people die on WA roads in 24 hours
items.description: Five people have been killed in separate crashes in Western Australia in less than 24 hours, as the state's road toll continues to soar.

items.title: 'If they put me in the freezer, I don't give a s***': Husic lashes Labor culture after push for Gaza debate fails
items.description: A push to recognise claims of genocide in Gaza failed to gain enough support for a debate on the floor of Labor's national conference, sparking criticism of the party's internal culture.

items.title: Live: Cowboys and Broncos fight out another Queensland derby
items.description: The Broncos and Cowboys are at it again in the latest instalment of the NRL's great Queensland rivalry. Follow live.

items.title: An addiction started at school landed Clay in a maximum-security prison
items.description: Clay first tried drugs during lunchtime at school. What followed was a decade of addiction and run-ins with police. Now he hopes sharing his story will help others.

items.title: Live: Tigers looking to challenge Dogs, Hawks and Swans dominate
items.description: Hawthorn records a 93-point win over Essendon at the MCG as Sydney puts GWS to the sword in the Battle of the Bridge. Follow live.

items.title: Iran's attacks on US bases in the Middle East mark 'end of an era'
items.description: Five months into a war Donald Trump said would last only weeks, the Iran conflict has so far cost the United States tens of billions of dollars and brought about "the end of an era" in American military strategy.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
